title: Captain Silas' Letter
wikitext:
'''Captain Silas' Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|17|A Call to Aid}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
To General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind

The days grow more dangerous with each passing hour, food has begun to get harder to find, and the numbers of our ranks is smaller than ever. If there is a hope for Lordaeron it is within the brave men and women who stand around me, fighting for what they believe in.

As the leader of the Alliance, I demand from you soldiers to assist the war in Lordaeron, I demand food and supplies to ease the troubles of our own gathering, do this and you shall be rewarded greatly when we achieve victory.

Yours truly, Captain Silas, The Army of Lordaeron
}}
